root_cause: Impact damage to the glass/LCD/OLED panel and digitizer.
checks: Inspect frame for bending|Test touch response on all screen areas|Check for liquid-damage indicators|Verify no swelling battery under the panel
repair_action: Replace display assembly; recalibrate touch and True Tone/auto-brightness where applicable.
symptoms: Phone fell and the screen is cracked with spider web lines, touch still works
Nahulog ang phone basag ang screen may mga green lines at black spots
Screen shattered after drop, display has ink spots and lines spreading
Tablet screen glass broke at the corner, touch works partially, cracked display

diagnosis: Faulty display (no physical damage) / flex or panel failure
root_cause: Failed LCD/OLED panel or loose display flex cable without visible impact.
checks: Reseat display flex cable|Test with known-good display|Check for pressure marks|Rule out software by booting to recovery
repair_action: Reseat or replace display flex; replace display assembly if panel is defective.
symptoms: Vertical green line appeared on the screen, no drop, and it keeps spreading
Screen flickers and has pink and purple lines, not dropped before
Dead pixels and white spots on the display that grow bigger over time
Display flashing and horizontal lines after normal use, no physical damage

root_cause: Li-ion cell capacity loss after many charge cycles; high internal resistance causes voltage drops.
checks: Read battery health / cycle count|Measure charging current with USB meter|Check for swelling|Compare drain against idle test
repair_action: Replace battery and run a full charge/discharge calibration.
symptoms: Battery drains very fast, percentage drops from 50 to 10 quickly and phone shuts off at 20%
Mabilis maubos ang battery kahit hindi ginagamit, nag-shutdown bigla kahit may 30%
Phone dies quickly, battery life is only a couple of hours, battery health is poor
Tablet battery does not last, drains even on standby and turns off randomly at low percentage

root_cause: Gas build-up in the Li-ion/Li-poly cell from age, overcharging or heat; may deform the chassis.
checks: Stop charging immediately|Look for lifting screen/back cover or raised trackpad|Do not puncture or press the cell|Check charger output
repair_action: Safely remove and recycle the swollen battery, replace with new cell, inspect chassis/screen for damage.
symptoms: Back cover is lifting and the screen is bulging, battery looks swollen and bloated
Trackpad is raised and the case is bulging at the bottom, laptop does not sit flat
Screen is lifting from the frame, battery expanded and phone feels hot while charging
Laptop base is bulging and the keyboard is pushed up, battery swollen

diagnosis: Faulty charging port (dirty, loose or damaged)
root_cause: Debris/lint in the port or worn/bent connector pins; solder joints cracked by repeated plugging.
checks: Inspect port with magnification for lint|Try a known-good cable and charger|Wiggle test for intermittent contact|Measure charge current
repair_action: Clean the port; if pins are worn or broken replace the charging port sub-board or solder a new connector.
symptoms: Phone only charges when I hold the cable at a certain angle, charging port feels loose
Not charging unless the lightning cable is pressed in, there is lint inside the port
Ayaw mag charge kailangan i-wiggle ang charger, cable keeps disconnecting
Charging is very slow and sometimes does not charge at all, type c port loose

root_cause: Liquid ingress causing corrosion and short circuits on the logic board and connectors.
checks: Check liquid-contact indicators|Disconnect battery immediately; do not charge|Inspect board under microscope for corrosion|Ultrasonic clean and test rails
repair_action: Disassemble, ultrasonic clean the board, replace corroded components/connectors and test all functions.
parts: Varies: connectors, ICs, display or battery
symptoms: Phone fell in water, nabasa then stopped working properly, screen has colored lines and speaker crackles
Nalubog sa tubig kahapon, hindi na mag-on and charger port shows corrosion
Coffee spilled on the keyboard, laptop now shuts off and some keys not working
Phone got wet in the rain, touch goes crazy and battery drains quickly, moisture detected

root_cause: Corrupted firmware or failed update; sometimes aggravated by low storage or a failing battery.
checks: Try forced restart|Boot to recovery/fastboot and check for update errors|Back up data if possible|Reflash firmware and test
repair_action: Reflash or restore firmware (preserving data when possible), then verify storage and battery health.
symptoms: Phone is stuck on the logo and keeps restarting after a software update
Stuck on the apple logo, bootloop, update failed and now it keeps rebooting
Nag-bootloop pagkatapos mag-update, hindi makapasok sa home screen, stuck at logo
Tablet restart loop after OS update, recovery mode shows an error

root_cause: Failing digitizer layer or touch IC connection; ghost touches often caused by moisture or a bad screen replacement.
checks: Run a touch diagnostic/test grid|Remove screen protector and case|Check display flex seating|Test with known-good display
repair_action: Replace display assembly (digitizer) or reseat/replace the touch flex; re-test with touch grid.
symptoms: Ghost touch, phone touches by itself and types by itself, touchscreen is unreliable
Part of the screen does not respond to touch, there is a dead zone on the left side
Ayaw mag-touch ang kalahati ng screen, touch lag and unresponsive in some areas
Tablet touch is not responding in the middle, randomly opens apps by itself

root_cause: Clogged speaker mesh, damaged speaker coil, or loose audio flex/connector.
checks: Test with headphones to isolate speaker|Clean speaker grille|Play test tones at various volumes|Check audio settings and software
repair_action: Clean mesh; replace loudspeaker or earpiece module; reseat audio connector.
symptoms: No sound from the speaker, calls are muffled and ringtone is very low
Walang tunog ang speaker, crackling and distorted sound when playing music
Cannot hear the caller on the earpiece, only works with loudspeaker
Laptop speakers have no sound and there is crackling noise at high volume

root_cause: Blocked or failed microphone element, or damaged mic flex/board connection.
checks: Record test with the voice recorder app|Test each mic (bottom/top/rear)|Clean mic ports|Inspect mic flex and solder joints
repair_action: Clean or replace microphone element / charging-port sub-board that carries the mic.
symptoms: People cannot hear me during calls, my voice is not heard but I can hear them
Microphone not working, voice messages are silent and the caller cant hear me
Dili madungog ang boses ko sa call, mic problem even on speaker mode
Built-in laptop microphone does not pick up voice in meetings

root_cause: Failed camera sensor/OIS, damaged lens, or loose camera flex.
checks: Test front and rear cameras in different apps|Inspect lens for cracks/dust|Check for OIS rattling|Rule out software with safe mode
repair_action: Replace the camera module (or lens glass if only the lens is cracked).
symptoms: Rear camera is blurry and shaking, camera app shows a black screen sometimes
Camera error, cannot focus, photos are blurry with a dark spot
Ayaw mag-open ang camera, front camera is black and selfie is not working
Back camera lens is cracked and photos have a blur and autofocus keeps hunting

diagnosis: Wi-Fi / Bluetooth antenna or module fault
root_cause: Antenna connector loose, Wi-Fi/BT chip or board fault, or driver corruption on laptops.
checks: Forget and rejoin networks / reset network settings|Test on multiple routers|Check antenna connector seating|For laptops reinstall wireless driver
repair_action: Reseat or replace antenna; replace Wi-Fi card (laptops) or reball/replace Wi-Fi IC (phones).
symptoms: Wifi is greyed out and cannot turn on, bluetooth also not working
Keeps disconnecting from wifi and weak signal even near the router
Laptop shows no wifi networks and the wireless adapter is missing
Cannot connect bluetooth earphones, wifi connection drops all the time

diagnosis: Cellular / SIM reader or baseband fault
root_cause: Damaged SIM tray/reader, antenna flex, or baseband/RF component failure.
checks: Test known-good SIM in another phone|Check SIM tray and reader pins|Verify IMEI/baseband status|Reset network settings
repair_action: Replace SIM tray/reader; repair antenna flex or RF components as required.
symptoms: No service and the sim card is not detected, shows emergency calls only
Searching for signal all the time and no network, invalid sim message
Walang signal, hindi ma-detect ang sim card kahit palitan ng ibang sim
Mobile data not working, weak network signal even in the city, imei shows unknown

diagnosis: Power / volume button or flex fault
root_cause: Worn button contacts or damaged side flex cable.
checks: Test button in recovery or button-test app|Check for debris around the button|Inspect flex connector|Verify with accessibility alternatives
repair_action: Clean contacts; replace power/volume flex cable.
symptoms: Power button is stuck and does not click, I cannot turn on or lock the screen
Volume button not working and the side button feels loose
Ayaw mag-click ng power button, kailangan pang idiin nang malakas
Tablet power button is unresponsive, only wakes when charging

root_cause: Short on a power rail or failed power-management IC, often after liquid, drop or power surge.
checks: Measure current draw on a bench supply|Thermal camera for hot component|Test with known-good battery/display|Check for burnt components
repair_action: Board-level repair: locate shorted rail, replace failed IC/capacitor; otherwise replace the board.
symptoms: Phone is completely dead, no signs of life, does not charge and no vibration after a power surge
Hindi na mag-on at hindi na nagcha-charge, mainit ang likod habang naka-charger and burnt smell
Laptop wont turn on after a brownout, no power lights at all with a known good charger
Phone suddenly died, wont power on, draws no current and gets hot near the board

diagnosis: Overheating (blocked cooling / thermal paste / software load)
root_cause: Dust-clogged heatsink and fan, dried thermal paste, or runaway background processes causing thermal throttling.
checks: Monitor CPU/GPU temps under load|Listen for fan speed and noise|Inspect vents for dust|Check for malware/high CPU processes
repair_action: Open chassis, clean fan and heatsink, replace thermal paste/pads, verify temps under load.
symptoms: Laptop gets very hot and the fan is loud, shuts down when playing games
Overheating and slow, init ang keyboard area, fan noisy all the time and shuts off randomly
Gets too hot, throttles and the fan sounds like whirring, vents are dusty
Laptop heats up quickly and turns off by itself after 20 minutes of use

diagnosis: Phone overheating (battery / charging IC / heavy software load)
root_cause: Aged battery, charging IC fault, or a runaway app causing continuous high load.
checks: Check battery temperature in diagnostics|Test with original charger|Boot safe mode to rule out apps|Inspect for swelling
repair_action: Replace battery or charging IC as indicated; remove problematic apps or reflash software.
symptoms: Phone gets very hot while charging and the battery drains fast
Mainit na mainit ang phone kahit walang ginagawa, nag-iinit ang battery area
Phone overheats when using camera or games and displays a temperature warning
Gets hot even on standby, battery percentage drops quickly and the phone slows down

diagnosis: Failing storage drive (HDD/SSD) or corrupted OS install
root_cause: Failing HDD/SSD (bad sectors) or corrupted Windows installation causing slow boot and read errors.
checks: Run SMART diagnostics|Listen for clicking from HDD|Check BIOS drive detection|Back up data before any repair
repair_action: Clone data if possible, replace drive with SSD and reinstall OS and drivers.
symptoms: Laptop takes forever to boot and keeps freezing, there is a clicking noise from the hard drive
Operating system not found, disk read error and files are missing or corrupted
Very slow, takes long to open anything and shows a disk error on startup
Windows wont boot, stuck on startup repair and the ssd is not detected in bios

root_cause: Worn key membrane, liquid residue under keys, or detached keyboard ribbon.
checks: Run keyboard test utility|Inspect for liquid residue|Reseat keyboard ribbon cable|Check external keyboard works
repair_action: Clean contacts or replace laptop keyboard assembly.
symptoms: Some keys are not working, letters are missing when typing and a few keys are sticky
Keyboard types wrong characters and several keys do not respond
Hindi gumagana ang ilang keys ng keyboard, spacebar stuck
Keyboard backlight not working and multiple keys dead after cleaning

diagnosis: Laptop display panel / LCD cable / backlight fault
root_cause: Damaged LCD panel, worn display cable at the hinge, or failed backlight/inverter circuit.
checks: Connect external monitor to isolate GPU vs panel|Flex the lid to test cable|Shine a flashlight on the screen for backlight|Inspect panel for pressure damage
repair_action: Replace LCD panel or display (eDP) cable; repair backlight circuit if board-level.
symptoms: Screen flickers when I move the lid and works fine on an external monitor
Laptop screen is very dim, image is only visible with a flashlight, backlight problem
Cracked laptop screen with vertical lines after being pressed in the bag
Display shows horizontal lines and goes blank at certain lid angles, external hdmi works

root_cause: Faulty adapter or damaged DC jack/charging connector on the motherboard.
checks: Test with a known-good adapter|Measure adapter output voltage|Wiggle test on the DC jack|Check for burnt pins or loose solder joints
repair_action: Replace adapter; resolder or replace DC jack / charging cable harness.
symptoms: Laptop not charging, plugged in but not charging and the charger light is off
Charger not detected, only works when the cable is held at an angle, dc jack loose
Laptop runs on battery only, the adapter is not recognized and the port feels loose
Battery stuck at 0 percent while plugged in, charger port wobbles

root_cause: Faulty or poorly seated memory module causing crashes, beep codes or no boot.
checks: Reseat RAM modules|Run memory diagnostic (MemTest)|Test modules one at a time|Listen for beep codes
repair_action: Clean contacts and reseat; replace defective RAM module.
symptoms: Laptop gives continuous beeping on startup and nothing shows on the screen
Random blue screens and the computer restarts randomly, memory error reported
Crashes randomly and turns off, fans spin but no display after adding a new ram
Frequent blue screen with memory management error and random restarts

root_cause: Malware, bloat, or a corrupted OS profile causing sluggish performance and pop-ups.
checks: Check task manager/process list|Run anti-malware scan|Check storage free space|Review startup programs
repair_action: Remove malware, clean startup items, update drivers/OS; reinstall OS if corrupted.
symptoms: Laptop is very slow and laggy with pop ups and ads, probably a virus
Mabagal na ang laptop, nag-hang kapag marami ang bukas and ads appear everywhere
Phone is laggy and hangs, storage is full and pop up ads keep appearing
Tablet is sluggish and freezes often, keeps showing ads after installing apps

root_cause: Broken hinge brackets or cracked plastic around the hinge mounts due to stress or impact.
checks: Open the lid gently and inspect hinge mounts|Check for cracked hinge covers|Look for pinched display cable|Test lid hold at different angles
repair_action: Replace hinge set and repair/replace cracked bezel or hinge covers.
symptoms: The lid wont stay open and the left hinge is broken, plastic cracked near the hinge
Laptop screen wobbles and the cover is loose, creaking when opening, hinge snapped
Hinge is broken and the screen separates from the base when opened
Nahulog ang laptop, basag ang plastic sa may hinge at hindi na maisara nang maayos

root_cause: Failed touchpad ribbon connection, swollen battery pressing on trackpad, or driver issue.
checks: Check driver and touchpad setting|Inspect for raised/swollen battery|Reseat touchpad ribbon|Test with external mouse
repair_action: Reinstall driver; reseat or replace trackpad assembly (and battery if swollen).
symptoms: Touchpad is not working, cursor does not move and clicking does not respond
Trackpad is unresponsive and cannot click, mouse works fine
Hindi gumagana ang touchpad, cursor freezes and click is stuck
Trackpad click is not working and the cursor jumps around randomly

root_cause: Faulty RAM, CPU/GPU solder issue, corrupted BIOS, or display path fault preventing POST.
checks: Hard reset (remove battery, hold power)|Reseat RAM|Test with external monitor|Listen for fan/HDD activity and beep codes
repair_action: Reseat/replace RAM; reflash BIOS; board-level reflow/replacement if GPU or CPU fault.
symptoms: Powers on, fans spin and lights are on but there is no display at all
Laptop turns on but screen stays black, no POST and nothing on external monitor
Turns on and off by itself, power light on but black screen and no boot
Lights on but no display, starts then stops after a few seconds

root_cause: Debris or damaged contacts in the 3.5 mm jack, or a faulty audio switch.
checks: Clean the jack|Test multiple headsets|Check whether the phone thinks headset is plugged in|Test Bluetooth audio as a control
repair_action: Clean jack; replace audio jack or sub-board.
symptoms: Earphones are not detected and the phone is stuck in headset mode, no sound on speaker
Headphone jack is loose and sound only comes out of one earphone
Laptop headphone port is not working and no audio on the earphones
Aux jack has crackling sound when I move the plug, earphone not detected
